tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan gyi gnas bshad bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /chos sku kun bzang gnyis pa ni/ /kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus sogs/ /chos rje yab sras rnam bzhi yi/ /zhabs kyi pad mo la btud de/ /'dir tshogs rnams la byin gyis rlobs/ sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan 'di'i che ba'i dbang du byas na/ shes rab e yig chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog /waṃ yig bde ba che dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /zung 'jug ye shes mtshon pa'i brda thabs can/ /gnas kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung*/ / lhun stug brag ri yangs shing mtho ba ni/ /rnam dag lta ba mtho zhing yangs pa mtshon/ /de la bya rgyal 'phur lding rol ba ni/ /nyams rtogs yon tan sna tshogs 'char ba'i rtags/ /rtsa ba me tog 'bras bu'i tshal gyis mdzes/ /rtags dang nyams myong phyogs med shar ba mtshon/ /ri dwags tshogs rnams dga' zhing rtse ba'i gnas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba skyong ba'i rtags/ /gsang ba nam mkha'i khams kyi phug pa ni/ /rdo rje phag mo'i gnas mchog pā ṭa na/ /rang byung mchod rten gnas dang mtshungs pa ste/ /dus dang dus la bdud rtsi'i dri bzang 'byung*/ /de yang gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud las gsungs pa/ tse t+ya pā ṭa na mchod rten gyi grong khyer zhes kyang bya/ dgyes rdor dang kha sbyor sogs las/ tsā ri tra zhes bshad pa/ rgya gar lho phyogs na 'phrin las kyi rdo rje phag mo'i rang byung gi gnas myos byed bzang po'i dri rang byung du 'thul ba zhig yod pa yin la/ de dang mtshungs par gnas mchog dam pa 'dir yang*/ rdo rje phag mos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rang byung gi gnas yin pa'i rtags su dus bzang ci rigs pa la nang mchod kyi dri bzang po rang byung du 'thul ba'i rnam pa da lta yang 'byung*/ de la gnas 'dir chos rje kun spangs chen pos/ sgrub gnas kyi dge mtshan du ma yod par gzigs te/

dbyar dgun bcu gsum tsam bzhugs/ de rjes yab sras gzhan gnyis kyis kyang thog re bzhugs shing*/ de nas kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang la sogs pa du mas rim can du bzhugs/ khyad par kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis kyang lo gnyis bzhugs shing*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzab bshad thog mar mdzad pa'i gnas yin la/ yang sngon chos rje kun spangs chen pos slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa dngos su zhal gzigs/ lam 'bras kyi 'khrugs sdeb pa dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi ṭī ka gyis shig par lung bstan pa yang brnyes/ lam 'bras kyi bstan bcos rnams kyang 'dir mdzad par gda' bas/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen yang yin no/ / zhus dag//dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum//sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan gyi gnas bshad bzhugs/ - PAGE 318 -- PAGE 155 -- PAGE 154 -
